newsitem.title: TURKEY: Nine dead in armed raid on Turkish house.
newsitem.headline: Nine dead in armed raid on Turkish house.

text.p: Unknown assailants raked a house with gunfire in Istanbul on Sunday, killing nine people including children, the state-run Anatolian news agency said.

It said the gunmen raided the house in the city's Esenler district at 4 a.m. (0100 GMT) and shot dead nine members of a family from Turkey's mainly-Kurdish southeast. The attackers then fled, Anatolian said in a brief report.
